intro.zh: 我是承意 CY-CharmYee。承你所想，会你所意。你可以让我处理视频和文稿，也可以通过持续对话建立生活、工作、学习知识库；开启后在日常相关任务中主动结合你的资料提供帮助。
intro.en: Meet CY-CharmYee: a personal knowledge and media creation assistant. Work with video and text, or build a life, work and learning knowledge base through ongoing conversation, then use its context proactively in relevant everyday tasks.

zh.title: 提取文字与校对
zh.example: 把这条视频转成文字，检查专名
zh.outcome: 抖音、本地音视频或批量素材的逐字稿、校对稿与疑点；新增语音识别需要豆包配置

en.title: Transcribe and proofread
en.example: Transcribe this video and check names
en.outcome: Raw and reviewed transcripts from Douyin, local media, or batches, with uncertainties; new speech recognition requires Doubao setup

zh.title: 分析内容与博主
zh.example: 按时间分析这个博主的内容和选题
zh.outcome: 有作品依据的逐条分析、阶段与账号总结；也能只分析已有文稿或标题文案，无需新增语音识别

en.title: Analyze content and creators
en.example: Analyze this creator's content and topics over time
en.outcome: Evidence-based item, period, and account analysis; existing text or captions-only analysis needs no new speech recognition

zh.title: 批量下载主页视频
zh.example: 下载这个博主全部可获取的视频
zh.outcome: 独立视频、发布文案与元数据，默认最高可用画质，可选省空间；不调用语音识别

en.title: Download profile videos
en.example: Download all accessible videos from this creator
en.outcome: Independent videos, captions, and metadata at the best available quality or a compact option; no speech calls

zh.title: 改口播与压缩文稿
zh.example: 把这份稿改成一分钟口播，保留核心观点
zh.outcome: 可直接读的改稿，必要时附前后对照；已有文字无需语音 Key，原文另存

en.title: Rewrite and shorten scripts
en.example: Turn this draft into a one-minute spoken script, keeping its main points
en.outcome: A readable rewrite with comparisons when needed; existing text needs no speech key, and the original is retained

zh.title: 整理与导出
zh.example: 把这批文稿按顺序整理成 TXT，再导出已有识别的字幕
zh.outcome: 顺序编号的 TXT、Markdown 或基于已有识别时码的 SRT；已有 SRT 可交给 Agent 保留时码处理，纯文本不能凭空生成准确时码

en.title: Organize and export
en.example: Combine these drafts into ordered TXT and export subtitles from existing recognition
en.outcome: Ordered TXT, Markdown, or SRT from existing recognition timing; an Agent can edit existing SRT while preserving timing, but plain text cannot supply accurate timestamps

zh.title: 归档与整理知识
zh.example: 把这批资料存入知识库，并整理成主题笔记
zh.outcome: 保留来源的原文与校对稿、整理主题页；按明确要求或已开启的知识库范围执行

en.title: Archive and organize knowledge
en.example: Archive these sources and synthesize topic notes
en.outcome: Linked original and reviewed sources with topic notes, under explicit requests or enabled knowledge collection scope

zh.title: 个人知识库与对话建档
zh.example: 帮我建立知识库，从学习、工作或生活里我最关心的事开始聊
zh.outcome: 逐轮深入、可暂停和续接的访谈；生活、工作、学习资料与成果按授权主动积累，日常任务先查相关资料，也可指定本次不保存

en.title: Personal knowledge and conversational profiles
en.example: Build my knowledge base, starting with the learning, work or life topic I care about most
en.outcome: Ongoing, resumable interviews and opted-in life, work and learning context; proactive relevant retrieval and outcome collection, with pause and no-save controls

zh.title: 续跑与重新分析
zh.example: 接着上次做，只处理没完成的部分
zh.outcome: 复用有效缓存、补未完成项；重新分析不会自动重新识别，付费失败重试需明确要求

en.title: Resume and reanalyze
en.example: Continue the previous task and handle only unfinished items
en.outcome: Reuse valid cached work; reanalysis does not automatically retranscribe, and failed paid calls require an explicit retry request

zh.title: 配置、排障与更新
zh.example: 帮我配置语音，或检查这个 Skill 有没有新版
zh.outcome: 引导配置、检查环境、迁移目录、定位失败和更新；需要登录时由你本人完成

en.title: Setup, diagnostics, and updates
en.example: Help me configure speech or check for a Skill update
en.outcome: Guided setup, local checks, migration, troubleshooting, and updates; complete any needed login yourself

zh: 第一次先准备运行环境；语音 Key、知识库和抖音登录按任务需要配置，已有配置直接复用。不要把 Key 发到聊天里。
语音识别可能收费；博主批量分析先展示本批新增用量并取得授权，普通转写按本次明确要求执行并说明计费环节。仅下载和已有文字处理不调用语音识别，Agent 平台自身成本另计。
先在聊天里看到正文或分析结论、依据和处理范围，再获取详细文件。只能处理当前可访问的作品，缺失项会明确列出。
整套安装包含总入口和 6 个业务入口，共用配置与任务材料；直接说需求即可，熟悉后也可以点名使用某个入口。
en: Prepare the local runtime first. Configure speech credentials, a knowledge destination, or Douyin login only when the task needs them. Reuse existing settings; never send keys in chat.

Speech recognition may incur charges. Preview and authorize new speech usage for a creator batch; ordinary transcription follows the explicit request with its paid step explained. Downloads and existing text make no speech calls; Agent platform costs are separate.
See readable text or analysis, evidence, and coverage in chat before opening detailed files. Only currently accessible posts can be processed; gaps are reported.
The suite includes one coordinator and six business entrypoints sharing configuration and task materials. Describe your goal, or name a specific entrypoint when you prefer.
